state.question: These numbered clips are shuffled segments from one cooking video. Determine their chronological order. Return only clip numbers joined by ->.
state.summary: All requirements have been supported by the available evidence, allowing for the determination of the chronological order of the cooking steps.

attempts: The order of adding ingredients to the bowl is identified: minced garlic is added first, followed by chopped onions.
The sequence of mixing and pouring actions in the bowl is determined: brown sugar is added to the onions, and then the mixture is stirred with a wooden spoon.
The chronological order of marinating meat in the dark liquid is established: raw meat is placed into the marinade, and then it is mixed thoroughly.

events.description: A wooden spoon rests in a clear bowl. Background contains measuring cups and a metal bowl.
Chopped white onions are added to the bowl and gathered by hand.
A block of brown sugar is placed on the chopped onions. Then, brown sugar is sprinkled over it.
The brown sugar and onions are mixed with a wooden spoon, breaking up the sugar block.
A dark liquid is poured into the bowl with the sugar and onion mixture.
A dark liquid is poured into the bowl with the sugar and onion mixture.
A wooden spoon stirs a dark, chunky mixture in a glass bowl under warm lighting.
Person places a lettuce leaf over cooked ribs on a white plate.
Person wraps a lettuce leaf around a rib, forming a wrap.
Ribs are on a grill. Later, hands place lettuce leaves over cooked ribs on a paper-lined surface.
A glass bowl contains a dark marinade with visible chopped ingredients.
Raw meat slices are added to the marinade in the bowl.
Hands mix meat and marinade in the bowl, coating the meat thoroughly.
More meat is added and mixed into the marinade, followed by hand washing under running water.
A wooden spoon stirs granular ingredients in a glass bowl. A dark liquid begins to pour into the bowl.
The dark liquid mixes with the ingredients as the wooden spoon continues stirring. The mixture becomes more uniform.
A glass bowl contains a dark liquid and visible solid particles, possibly a marinade or brine.
A hand places a raw meat rib into the bowl of dark liquid and solids.
A hand submerges meat pieces into the bowl's liquid and solids, indicating marination.
A clear bowl with a wooden spoon and measuring cups in the background. No ingredients added yet.
A pile of minced garlic is added to the bowl, visible in the foreground.
Chopped onions scattered on wooden surface, out-of-focus bowl in background.
Clear glass bowl containing chopped onions comes into focus, positioned on wooden surface.
Hands enter frame, moving chopped onions from surface toward bowl.
Chopped onions are gathered into the glass bowl, which is now filled.

turns.summary: Determine if the dark liquid in v1 is the same as the marinade in v4 and whether the ribs in v2 are the same as the ribs in v3.
